high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user @sadiesink_. The post features two distinct sections. The top section shows a black-and-white photograph of a certificate titled "Certificate of Excellence for Interpretive Exorcism Dance." The certificate is awarded to "Sadie Sink" on April 14, 2025. The certificate has decorative borders and a seal at the bottom left corner. The background includes some blurred objects that appear to be part of a stage or performance setting, such as a white lampshade and what looks like a bottle or container.
